features.quote: Hard cap: 20 tool-call steps per trial.
features.justification_quote: Short enough that cost per run stays bounded

features.quote: Do not re-prompt the model to continue
exclude trials with <5 tool calls from metric computation

features.justification_quote: This informs whether the degradation is self-limiting
